CHAPTER.VERS:
Behold, how good and how pleasant for brethren to dwell together in unity!
together…: Heb. even together
like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garment;
As the dew of Hermon, that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, life for evermore.
